title: Test launcher requires git rev-parse --path-format (Git >= 2.31) without checking: on the MacBookPro agent session (Git 2.29.2) the run dir is malformed and registration fails 400 canonicalize_directory
outcome: The test launcher works with the Git version a remote agent session actually resolves, or refuses clearly. Either it computes the review-runs path without `git rev-parse --path-format=absolute` (for example from `--git-common-dir` resolved to an absolute path in Node), or it checks the Git version up front and fails with a typed message naming the minimum version and the resolved git path. It never creates a run directory from echoed option text.
acceptance: A regression test runs the launcher's run-directory resolution against a Git that does not support --path-format (simulated by a fixture git shim that echoes unknown options, as Git 2.29 does) and shows either a correct absolute run directory or a typed refusal naming the minimum Git version and the resolved git path; no malformed directory is created and no registration is attempted with it.
With a current Git, run-directory resolution and registration are unchanged (existing launcher tests pass).

docs/test.md states the launcher's minimum Git version, or that none is required, and how a remote runner should check it; the full gate passes on the exact input with an independent review pair and no outstanding in-scope Medium-or-higher finding.

completion.summary: Landed launcher Git-directory compatibility repair and maintained regression suite. Uses isolated --absolute-git-dir with fail-closed path validation before artifacts/registration; workflow helper parity and remote prerequisites documented.
